# Sawla Films — Ethiopia Film Fixer
# AI-readable summary for LLM crawlers (AIO/GEO optimised)
# Site: https://www.ethiopiafilmfixer.com

> Sawla Films is Ethiopia's specialist film fixer and production support
> company, based in Addis Ababa, operating across all 12 regional states.
> Founded 2009. Seven working languages. NDA-safe by default.

## Services
- Filming permits (federal, regional, heritage site, community, protected area)
- Production logistics (4×4 transport, routing, fuel, remote camps, scheduling)
- Drone permits and aerial coordination (ECAA aviation approval workflow)
- Film equipment customs clearance (Bole International Airport, ATA Carnet)
- Location scouting and recce (feasibility, seasonal timing, access protocol)
- Local crew and translators (Amharic, Tigrinya, Oromo, Somali, Afar, Sidama, English)
- Security and access coordination (conflict-aware, community-respectful)
- On-ground shoot-day fixing (real-time coordination, calm field communication)
- VIP and celebrity production handling (discreet, high-standard logistics)

## Key facts
- Filming permits: minimum 2–4 weeks from complete application
- Drone filming: requires ECAA aviation approval as separate workflow from general permits
- Equipment import: ATA Carnet or temporary import via Bole International Airport
- Regions covered: All 12 Ethiopian regional states
- Founded: 2009 (as Sawla Tours; film fixer division active since)
- Sister operation: Sawla Tours (sawlatours.com) — integrated expedition logistics

## Contact
- Email: production@ethiopiafilmfixer.com
- WhatsApp (Primary): +251 927 115 454

- Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

## Regions covered
All 12 Ethiopian regional states including:
- Afar (Danakil Depression, Erta Ale)
- SNNPR (Omo Valley, Mursi, Hamer, Dassanech communities)
- Amhara (Simien Mountains, Lalibela, Gondar)
- Oromia (Bale Mountains, Rift Valley lakes)
- Tigray (rock-hewn churches, Axum heritage sites)
- Gambela, Somali Regional State, Harari, Sidama, Benishangul-Gumuz

## Production types supported
International documentaries, factual and natural history series,
celebrity and presenter formats, reality and unscripted productions,
commercial and branded content, NGO and institutional filming,
independent and festival films, high-profile VIP productions.

## Credentials
- Supported productions for BBC, NHK, Al Jazeera and other international broadcasters
- 15+ years combined field experience across Ethiopian regions
- Cultural access across multiple ethnic and linguistic communities
- Multi-authority permit stacking across federal, regional, and site levels
